name: Jev client (TypeSafe Noul judge)
description: Method-layer client for TypeSafe's Jev. Given a fixture 'state' and a set of Noul questions, returns one probability in [0,1] per question. Installs the 'jev' bin, the third-party TypeSafe skill, and a first-party skill describing the capture -> validate -> jev -> probabilities chain. The API key is read from the environment (TYPESAFE_API_KEY) at call time, never baked into the image; wrap the call with pass-cli.
